covered_report_window: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the U.S. market close on Monday, August 31, 2026, plus companies reporting before the U.S. market open on Tuesday, September 1, 2026.
market_context_summary: U.S. equities were modestly lower as oil rose after U.S. strikes on Iranian sites and investors absorbed hawkish Federal Reserve commentary; Tuesday's ISM manufacturing and JOLTS releases add macro sensitivity to the next session.

ranked_companies.timing: Before U.S. open, Sep. 1, 2026; release about 6:45 a.m. ET
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Organic growth and FY27 guide progression
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: No guide raise; tariff and margin drag
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: New-product momentum and conservative guidance support a modest upside bias if organic growth clears the extra-week-adjusted bar and management raises or de-risks FY27 guidance.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $1.39 EPS and $9.55 billion revenue, while company guidance calls for Q1 organic growth of roughly 11.5%-12% and FY27 EPS of $5.90-$6.00.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Affera, Symplicity, Hugo and other launches sustain at least 6% underlying growth and management lifts or firmly de-risks the full-year outlook.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: The extra week masks softer underlying growth, tariffs pressure margin, or full-year guidance is merely reiterated against a beat-and-raise expectation.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options implied about a 5.0%-5.1% move, slightly above the stock's long-run average earnings move.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Needham expected a beat and FY27 guide raise; broader analyst tone was constructive and consensus targets remained above the market price.
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: Passes A, B and C all Lean Up

ranked_companies.timing: Before U.S. open, Sep. 1, 2026; call 8:00 a.m. ET
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Q2 delivery miss; weaker margin or guide
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Strong delivery growth and prior margin improvement support upside, but the Q2 delivery shortfall versus company guidance makes vehicle margin and the next delivery outlook decisive.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Q2 deliveries were 107,658, up 49.4% year over year but below the 110,000-115,000 guide; consensus loss and revenue estimates were about $0.07 per ADS and $4.78 billion.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Vehicle margin holds near 17%-18%, non-GAAP profitability persists, and management maintains a credible 40%-50% 2026 delivery-growth path.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Price competition, a softer mix, or another forward-delivery reset overwhelms the headline volume growth.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options implied roughly 9.4%-9.7%; retail attention and improving analyst tone can amplify either direction.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Goldman Sachs upgraded to Buy with a $7 target and Morgan Stanley raised its target to $6.50, reflecting better restructuring and ONVO expectations.
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: Passes A, B and C all Lean Up

ranked_companies.timing: Before U.S. open, Sep. 1, 2026; release 6:45 a.m. ET
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Flex launch, CGM attachment and organic growth
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Standalone costs and weak U.S. uptake
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Flex and Instinct launches plus higher CGM attachment support growth, but the first standalone quarterly setup carries cost and expectation risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus was about $827 million revenue and $0.09-$0.12 adjusted EPS; FY27 guidance calls for about 10% organic revenue growth and a 16% adjusted EBITDA margin.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Deferred U.S. demand converts into Flex shipments, CGM attachment keeps rising and management reiterates or improves the 10% organic growth framework.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: U.S. growth remains soft, standalone public-company costs dilute margins, or product mix weakens gross margin.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No sufficiently reliable earnings-implied-move benchmark was found; analyst positioning is heavily bullish, which raises the bar.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: BofA raised its target to $24 from $20 and most current ratings were Buy, but the average target was only modestly above the market price.
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: Passes A, B and C all Lean Up

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Low bar and cost-led EPS squeeze
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Shrinking total ARR, only 1% growth in larger-customer ARR and 97% net retention leave the stock exposed unless enterprise expansion or profitability improves sharply.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Analysts expected about $111.3 million revenue and $0.17 EPS after Q1 revenue fell 1% and total ARR declined to $440.8 million; management no longer provides quarterly guidance or calls.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Large-customer ARR and NRR inflect higher while cost discipline delivers an EPS and cash-flow beat against a de-risked stock.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Enterprise ARR remains nearly flat, sub-$50,000 churn persists and absent guidance keeps investors focused on weak organic growth.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options implied about 19.9%, richer than the stock's roughly 15.1% long-run average; the last earnings move was about -22.4%.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The next-quarter revenue estimate had been revised down about 2.4% over three months and coverage depth was thin.
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: Passes A, B and C all Lean Down

ranked_companies.timing: Before U.S. open, Sep. 1, 2026; call 8:30 a.m. ET
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Verified growth, buyback and short squeeze
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: The preliminary $127 million H1 headline is strong but already known, while the approximately $233 million H2 requirement and acquisition-heavy revenue bridge create sell-the-news and quality risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Management preannounced about $127 million H1 revenue and reaffirmed roughly $360 million for 2026, implying a steep second-half ramp.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Final numbers validate organic conversion, management shows a credible path to $360 million and $500 million exit ARR, and buyback timing pressures shorts.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: The organic versus acquired bridge is weak, profitability lags or management cannot substantiate the H2 acceleration.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Weekly options implied about 13.5%; short interest was roughly 11.6%, creating substantial upside-reversal risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Most analysts remained bullish with targets far above the stock, although the evidence base is unusually management-dependent.
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: Two Lean Down; one Neutral / No Edge

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Free cash flow, net debt and dividend
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Oil spike and stronger cash return
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Most earnings upside is preannounced and the stock has rerated, so cash conversion, leverage and dividends must beat a higher bar to avoid a sell-the-news reaction.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Sasol preannounced EPS growth of 65%-84%, HEPS growth of 2%-14% and adjusted EBITDA growth of 12%-20%; higher working capital remains a cash-flow risk.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Strong oil prices, better production, lower capex and disciplined costs drive a stronger dividend and faster debt reduction.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Working-capital absorption, chemicals weakness or cautious FY27 commentary overshadows already-known EBITDA growth.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No robust current implied-move benchmark was found; the ADR had rallied materially since the prior report, increasing sell-the-news risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The stock carried a broadly negative Reduce consensus despite the improved trading statement.
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: Two Lean Down; one Neutral / No Edge
